title: Make the feature verification tier actually runnable
working_tree_status: dirty (124 entries; the shared worktree carries concurrent lanes DB-013/014/015/016, WFC-003/007, ADMIN-012, DESIGN-034 and the logistics work. No commit was made.)
goal: Make verify:feature honor the --changed scope so the recorded verification tier is achievable instead of universally skipped.

in: Honoring --changed for the typecheck step in the feature tier (CP-106, CP-111)
Recording what the scoped substitute covers and does not cover, in the tier output and in docs/DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md
Inventorying and dispositioning the task records that name an unachievable verification command
Additively wiring DB-014 already-proven scripts/ci/check-sweep-exemption-hazard.mjs into package.json and ci.yml if it does not collide with DB-015
out: Raising the machine memory ceiling — the 8192 MB request is left exactly as it was and the scoped run uses the default heap
Weakening type coverage for the files the scoped program does contain
Fixing the two pre-existing type errors it surfaced, or quarantining check:admin-audit
npm run generate:database-types / check:database-types — the 1 MB ENOBUFS generator ceiling (CP-089, CP-092) is a separate constraint and was not touched
Any change to lib/database.types.ts, the `linked` Supabase project, or any application code

acceptance_criteria.criterion: verify:feature -- --changed scopes its typecheck step to changed files, or invokes a documented scoped substitute that is not the full-repo run
The fast tier's existing deferral behavior is unchanged and still exits 0
A task record can run its recorded tier to completion on this machine and get a truthful pass or fail
The 1 MB ENOBUFS type-generation ceiling is documented as a known separate constraint, not conflated
The count of task records specifying an unachievable verification command is inventoried and corrected or explicitly accepted

evidence: NEGATIVE CONTROL A (twice, reproducible): an untracked types/release010-negative-control.ts holding `export const release010NegativeControl: number = 'a string'` made `npm run verify:feature -- --changed` exit 2 and print `types/release010-negative-control.ts(3,14): error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'`. The scoped step is not vacuous. The file was deleted immediately after.

NEGATIVE CONTROL B (transitive, real, not a fixture): in a DETACHED CLEAN WORKTREE at 16fb834f, a changed root that only does `import '@/lib/services/account-management.service'` made the tier exit 2 with two real errors in that service (lines 1015 and 1025) — a file that is neither a root nor changed. The program reached unchanged code, and the errors are proven pre-existing at the base SHA.

ANTI-VACUITY GUARD: `--typecheck-scope` pointing at a project that omitted one changed file made the tier exit 1 with "the scoped typecheck did not cover 1 changed file(s): types/rel010-omitted.ts". Adding it to the same project made the tier exit 0 and the program grow from 2 to 3 repository files. A scoped run that silently skips a changed file fails loudly.

NOT-RUN PATH: a worktree whose only changes were .mjs/.json printed `typecheck: NOT RUN — --changed was passed and the worktree contains no changed TypeScript source.` and the closing RESULT line repeated "record as not-run, not as a pass". A 1-file program containing only next-env.d.ts is refused, because that is precisely the short-circuiting green CP-106 warns about.

GREEN END TO END: detached clean worktree at 16fb834f, `npm run verify:feature -- --changed` exit 0 in 4.0s, "RESULT: every step this tier ran passed. typecheck: scoped to 1 changed TypeScript root(s) ... 2 of 4303 repository TypeScript sources in the program".

TRUTHFUL RED END TO END: shared worktree, `npm run verify:feature -- --changed` exit 1 after the scoped typecheck PASSED, at check:supabase-target — credential-gated, triggered by other lanes untracked supabase/migrations, unrelated to this change.

BEFORE MEASUREMENT: `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=2048 tsc --noEmit` (the full program, the only heap this 8 GB host can actually grant) died in 19.9s with FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit / JavaScript heap out of memory and printed ZERO diagnostics. The requested 8192 MB exceeds physical RAM, so it was a request, not a grant.

SCOPE SIZE FACTS: scoped program with a database-importing root = 949 files, 27 repository sources, 576 MB peak RSS, 2.03s. Repository total the full program would contain = 4313 TypeScript sources (5474 tracked .ts/.tsx, minus the base tsconfig exclude globs). ci.yml measures the full typecheck at 68m18s on a 16 GB runner.

SWEEP CHECK WIRING: `npm run check:sweep-exemption-hazard` exit 0; `node --test scripts/ci/check-sweep-exemption-hazard.test.mjs` 11 tests pass. ci.yml parses as valid YAML, Migration Gates steps = [Checkout, Setup Node, Install pinned npm, Install dependencies, Migration validation lint, Sweep-exemption hazard fixtures, Sweep-exemption hazard (DB-014 / CP-107)]; no job added, renamed or removed, so no required status-check name in that file's header changes.

ADMIN-AUDIT PRE-EXISTENCE (re-proven here, not taken on trust): `npm run check:admin-audit` fails with exactly 3 findings (Generated view drift: STATUS.md; Generated view drift: coverage.json; Workbook registry source hash is stale). All 34 non-binary inputs it reads under docs/admin-audit/ plus lib/supabase/service-role-import-review.json, and the 35th input TOURIFY_ADMIN_WORKFLOW_TRACKER.xlsx, are byte-identical to HEAD 16fb834f by sha256. Nothing under docs/admin-audit or scripts/audit is modified in the worktree. NOT quarantined: a gate that fails is reported, not silenced.

FAST TIER — MEASURED TWICE, AND THE SECOND MEASUREMENT CORRECTS THE FIRST. The fast tier block is byte-identical to the pre-change file (empty diff of that block against the original), and the release tier block is byte-identical too. In a DETACHED CLEAN WORKTREE at base SHA 16fb834f with only scripts/verify.mjs changed, `npm run verify:fast -- --changed` printed "Fast verification complete. Full typecheck/build is intentionally deferred." and exited 0. LATER, in the shared dirty worktree, the same command exits 1 — at `npm run test:unit`, not at the deferral line: __tests__/admin/workforce-identity-contract.test.ts now fails with "expected [ …(3) ] to deeply equal [ …(2) ]" because a concurrent lane (DB-016/WFC-003) added supabase/migrations/20260926200000_org_role_permissions_workforce_seed.sql, a THIRD org_role_permissions seed statement. Both that test file and that migration are untracked work belonging to other lanes. This is a truthful failure in a step this change does not touch, and it is recorded here rather than left as a stale green.

FAST/RESLAVE TIER DO NO FILESYSTEM WORK: the scoped-typecheck directory is resolved lazily on first use by the scoped step, so `verify:fast`, `verify:release` and an unknown tier create nothing. Verified by deleting node_modules/.cache/tourify-verify and confirming `npm run verify:fast -- --changed` does not recreate it. An earlier draft resolved it at import time, which would have made the fast tier create a directory it never uses and throw on a host where neither candidate location is writable; that was caught before handoff and corrected, because AC2 requires the fast tier to be unchanged, not merely unchanged in its printed output.

checkpoints.summary: Implemented the scoped step and proved a database-importing scoped program fits: 2.03s, 576 MB peak RSS, 915 files including lib/database.types.ts. So the 25,648-line contract is NOT the memory problem; the size of the whole program is.

Negative control A: a deliberate type error in a changed root turned the tier red (exit 2, error named) — twice. Anti-vacuity guard, --typecheck-scope widening, the NOT RUN path, and a green end to end all exercised in a detached clean worktree at 16fb834f, then removed.

Found and fixed two defects in my own implementation, both of which would have produced a misleading green: node_modules type declarations counted as repository sources, and a non-TypeScript-only change yielding a 1-file passing program. This is the same failure family as the one being fixed, which is why the coverage figure and the NOT RUN path are now asserted rather than printed.
checkpoints.note: A third possible hole was checked and is not present: a root outside the repo or deleted between the two tsc passes would be caught by the missing-root assertion.
